decision_corpus_transfer.candidate_plan_policy: Use the same literal [PLAN_NOT_RECORDED_BY_DECISION_CORPUS] for both candidates; do not synthesize a plan from code or outcomes.
decision_corpus_transfer.candidate_code_policy: Full decision-time candidate code, no execution output and no candidate outcome.
decision_corpus_transfer.context_policy_requirement: Before any live call, freeze a deterministic builder over only same-task context nodes whose execution information was available before the candidate decision; exclude both candidates, later nodes, labels being predicted, private identities, and any post-decision information.

orientation_policy.parser: exactly one terminal boxed A or B in final content
orientation_policy.disagreement: abstain and report as position disagreement

known_deviations_from_rpm: Decision Corpus does not record candidate plans, so both receive a symmetric explicit missing-plan marker.
The benchmark uses two deterministic orientations per pair as a position-bias audit.
The exact Qwen3.6-27B checkpoint, serving stack, context-node packing, and reasoning-control interface are not yet matched.
This is an offline recorded-fragment benchmark, not RPM's online 15-child tournament or end-to-end intervention.
